description: This source file is a Java configuration class for setting up auditing and authentication filtering in a Spring Boot application. It defines beans for auditor awareness and a filter registration for authentication.

classes.name: AuditConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that sets up JPA auditing and registers a custom authentication filter.

methods.name: myAuditorProvider
methods.description: Defines a bean for providing the current auditor's identity, returning an instance of AuditorAwareConfig.

methods.name: authUserFilter
methods.description: Defines a bean that registers an authentication filter for URLs matching /api/*.
